title: Event health scorer and quarantine router for usage ingest
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: We need a lightweight real-time "event health" scoring service that assigns a probabilistic conformity score to incoming usage events and routes low-confidence events into a quarantine stream for further offline validation and possible automated backfill. This reduces noisy rejections in production, enables targeted schema rollups, and provides a feedback signal to SDKs and producers. The service must integrate with the existing ingress proxy, emit per-event metrics to the telemetry pipeline, and provide a human-readable explanation for low scores to aid debugging.
acceptance_criteria: Per-event health score computed within the ingress 10ms P95 budget for 99% of requests
Quarantine stream can be consumed by existing downstream validation jobs without schema changes
Dashboard with score distribution, top rejection reasons, and consumer replay controls available in Console
Automatic tagging of quarantined batches with candidate-schema-version and producer-sdk-id
SLA: Maintain false-positive quarantine rate < 0.5% on production traffic after 2 weeks of warmup
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: RFC drafted; decided to use lightweight probabilistic checks (field presence, type fingerprints, histogram-based vocab checks) rather than full schema validation to meet latency constraints.

2025-02-24: Spike completed showing a median 3.6ms added latency when scoring with in-memory rules; memory footprint per worker ~28MB. Trade-off: richer ML model rejected due to cold-start and complexity.
2025-02-28: Integration plan with ingress proxy approved by infra; will emit score and reason as header for routed events. QA will run canary on 10% of traffic.
2025-03-04: Quarantine S3 layout and consumer contract agreed (prefix: s3://r-infer-quarantine/{env}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{hour}). Added replay flag support for Console.
2025-03-05: Implemented metrics (score.histogram, quarantine.rate) and added initial dashboard panels. Canary rollout scheduled next cycle.
notes: Primary goal is to reduce noisy schema rejections and give operators a compact signal. We will iterate on scoring features after 2 weeks using labeled quarantine samples.
